- Refactored SKILL.md: now includes explicit skill path mapping and extended modular loading rules for each sub-skill.

- Skill dependencies now updated to explicitly include debugging and error recovery by default.
- Numerous agent YAMLs, rules, hooks, and references updated for consistency with new orchestration logic.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md and legacy references; all subsystems now documented in the main SKILL.md.
